description: Execute one live WebMCP tool in the user-selected active visible Chrome/Brave tab. Use the tab and generation values from list_webmcp_tools. If execution fails because the tab is not eligible or available, call focus_webmcp_tab with the target tabId, then retry. Registry-injected package tools retain their existing confirmation behavior. An execution-timeout error means the call may still have run - verify its effect before retrying. A dispatch-failed error confirms that the call did not run and can be retried.

input.description: JSON object passed to the WebMCP tool

name: execute_webmcp_tool
